name: vibeseo-search-console
description: A Google Search Console review workflow for the VibeSEO connector: clicks, impressions, CTR and position changes, traffic drops, queries close to page 1 and low-CTR pages turned into concrete fixes.

interface.longDescription:
Get a plain-language review of your Google Search Console data: how clicks, impressions, click-through rate and average position changed versus the previous period, when a traffic drop started, which queries are close to page 1, and which pages are shown often but rarely clicked. The review ends with concrete fixes ranked by expected impact, such as rewritten titles and meta descriptions or pages to refresh, each backed by a number from your data.

Requires the VibeSEO connector ("SEO Keywords by VibeSEO"): add it in one tap at https://chatgpt.com/plugins/plugin_asdk_app_6a1606dfad8c819190800c65ba5b56c4 and sign in. You also need a VibeSEO project for your site. Search Console must be connected to the project.
defaultPrompt: Why did my Google traffic drop and what should I fix first?
Which queries is my site close to ranking on page 1 for?
Which pages get impressions but few clicks, and how do I fix them?

publication.release_notes: Initial release: a guided Search Console review over the VibeSEO connector.
